scope: Full publication boundary harness, synthetic coverage fixtures and recording gh only; no external publication.
summaries: case positive: HELD (continuous path, upload recorded with exact identities)
case missing: HELD (exit 3, 'not a single committed path', no upload)
case injected-fault: HELD (exit 1, 'FAIL: checkout .* is not the tag commit', no upload)
case marker-deleted: HELD (exit 1, 'FAIL: dirty or unreadable working tree', no upload)
case nonrepo: HELD (exit 1, 'FAIL: checkout .* is not the tag commit', no upload)
case guard-absent: HELD (exit 1, assembly attempted, missing-flake env failure, pre-integration proceed)
case guard-removed: HELD (assembly PASSED on INCOMPLETE without guard, no upload — guard is load-bearing)
case no-final: HELD (exit 0, assembly PASS, mutated path executed, no upload — composition proven)
closure audit: recorder present, no gh package present
